reason: As someone hired remote, I'd find A more persuasive because it gives me practical help: the $150 commuting support, the desks arriving before the start date, the meeting time and place, and a named person to contact. It also says plainly that there will be no other exceptions. B is warmer, but it leaves out the commuting help, gives no meeting time, and is signed with unfilled placeholder names, so it reads as unfinished.
